children: Mary Beth Laughton, a Director, reported a sale of common stock on August 27, 2026. The filing reports a weighted average selling price of $50.3273 per share. The total reported proceeds from the sale were $515,150. The reporter disposed of 10,236 shares in the transaction. Following the sale, the reporter directly owns 10,890 shares of common stock. The filing notes the shares were sold in multiple transactions at prices ranging from $50.31 to $50.3750 per share.
